title: Have You Ever Heard of the Mooring Ghosts

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Have you ever heard of the Mooring Ghosts?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Have you ever heard of the Mooring Ghosts?

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Sorry, that was random. I was just excited to see you. I thought I saw them, the Mooring Ghosts, that is and I didn't have anyone to talk to about it and then boom... Here you are.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sorry, that was random. I was just excited to see you. I thought I saw them, the Mooring Ghosts, that is and I didn't have anyone to talk to about it and then boom... Here you are.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Me too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me too.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: I know. Hence why I don't have many people to talk to about these things. At least in Nivalis that is. Maybe my kind of people are somewhere else entirely.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know. Hence why I don't have many people to talk to about these things. At least in Nivalis that is. Maybe my kind of people are somewhere else entirely.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Tech-nic-ally they're a myth. A legend lost in neon lights. But I think they're real. I swear I saw one last night. After all the time I've spent at the Docks, I finally saw one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Tech-nic-ally they're a myth. A legend lost in neon lights. But I think they're real. I swear I saw one last night. After all the time I've spent at the Docks, I finally saw one.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Ghosts of those who died on the docks, back when Nivalis was solely focused on reaching the clouds. No one paid attention to the sea anymore. They just wanted to go up. Up, up, up and gone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ghosts of those who died on the docks, back when Nivalis was solely focused on reaching the clouds. No one paid attention to the sea anymore. They just wanted to go up. Up, up, up and gone.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Well, it's said that they lure coders I guess they hum a Lo-Fi rhythm and draw them to their deaths with the promise of a perfect software patch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, it's said that they lure coders I guess they hum a Lo-Fi rhythm and draw them to their deaths with the promise of a perfect software patch.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: I wish. But I swear I saw them. Maybe I didn't hear it because I'm not a coder?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I wish. But I swear I saw them. Maybe I didn't hear it because I'm not a coder?

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Guess I just have to listen harder. I should get started. You know where to find me!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Guess I just have to listen harder. I should get started. You know where to find me!

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: A dreamer. I think. That's what I like to see myself as. Do you dream?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A dreamer. I think. That's what I like to see myself as. Do you dream?

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: I hope that changes for you at some point. You don't know what you're missing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope that changes for you at some point. You don't know what you're missing.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: It's even better when you dream by day. That's when you know what's truly on your mind.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's even better when you dream by day. That's when you know what's truly on your mind.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: I know, right? Still, kind of cool when you think about it. Makes you believe there's another world out there. One we can't always see. Just gotta keep looking I guess.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know, right? Still, kind of cool when you think about it. Makes you believe there's another world out there. One we can't always see. Just gotta keep looking I guess.

nodes.speaker: Zee Burke
nodes.text: Well, it's said that they lure coders who are stuck and trying to clear their head to the sea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, it's said that they lure coders who are stuck and trying to clear their head to the sea.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Mooring Ghosts?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Mooring Ghosts?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hi to you too.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hi to you too.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I think so. What are they again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think so. What are they again?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I think so. What are they again?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I think so. What are they again?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're such an oddball.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're such an oddball.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Well, I'm glad I'm here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I'm glad I'm here.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So, about these ghosts.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, about these ghosts.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are they?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are they?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Seeing ghosts is a good thing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Seeing ghosts is a good thing?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Seeing ghosts is a good thing?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Seeing ghosts is a good thing?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And what do they do? Like what's the myth?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And what do they do? Like what's the myth?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: And what do they do? Like what's the myth?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: And what do they do? Like what's the myth?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Morbid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Morbid.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's cool! Did you hear them humming?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's cool! Did you hear them humming?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's cool! Did you hear them humming?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's cool! Did you hear them humming?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Maybe.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Maybe.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What would you say you are?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What would you say you are?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What would you say you are?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What would you say you are?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Nope. Nothing but sound sleep.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nope. Nothing but sound sleep.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I do. It's the best of the night.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do. It's the best of the night.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I do. It's the best of the night.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I do. It's the best of the night.
